test_case_name: Login as guest on desktop with remember me checked

intents.intent: Type $email into the input with placeholder 'E-mail' and type 'text'
Type $password into the input with placeholder 'Password' and type 'password'
Click the checkbox with id 'rememberMe2' labeled 'Mantieni L'accesso' to enable remember me
Click the 'ENTRA' button to log in as guest
And then check that the guest user is logged in and the session is remembered
